headline: Turkish Consumer Confidence Rebounds 2.4% in November
summary: Consumer confidence in Türkiye rose 2.4% month-on-month in November as household financial expectations improved, according to data from the Turkish Statistical Institute. The index rebounded after months of tighter domestic financial conditions.
why: Turkish consumer confidence metrics provide insights into household inflation expectations and baseline economic demand.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Household expectation improvements pushed Türkiye's consumer sentiment index up 2.4%.
